what: `could_be_narrower` for parameters and fields (the owner's case: a type that could be more specific) needs every call's argument as a value range, but the workspace use rows only keep `Unseen | Same(Constant) | Varies` per parameter, so only function results (one body) are built.
cost: the lint covers returns only; params and fields wait for a range variant in another lane's rows and for the fold to be wired
cause: the workspace use rows were designed for one question (is it always the same constant) instead of as per-site observations that any join can fold
class: workspace facts stored pre-joined for one lint, so a second lint over the same sites needs its own pass
prevention: store per-site observations as `ItemRows` records and let each lint be a `fold::Join` over them (constant_argument is `Same`, could_be_narrower is `Narrow`), one pass of rows for both
workaround: none: the params/fields case is designed in could_be_narrower.rs's module doc, not built
